name: Kimura
source:
Pronouns: He/Him
Occupation: Head of Central

Powers: Water Control
Dragon Spring: Ryujin

The head of Central, Kimura. His name is known by all. As the head, he holds immense power and responsibility to maintain the safety of the town. Few know the details behind his rise to power or even what dragon abilities he has. However, his title alone commands respect. His time as the head of Central has been focused on addressing the Overtaken Crisis and the Dragon Energy Crisis. Many seem to be appreciative of his efforts.

[From in-game profile]
